sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the equipment Inspection checklist I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
 indicated by Y1 in the above title block. 
The first draft initiated by eng. Emad Farouk Mostafa at 
Kattamia
substation 220kv

Safety 
Precaution

A work 
 order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,

Transformer isolation and proper grounding on 
 all its sides is required.

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,

Wear your 
 safety helmet, safety shoes, and safety belt when cleaning suspension 
 Insulator.

There is a danger falling into the containment pit when working 
 near large transformer.

It is recommended to use only fiberglass (PVC) ladders when working 
 in the switchyard.

sections.text: Environmental Recommendation

Before 
 starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of all transformer wear your 
 breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.

Don't 
 burn the cloth used in cleaning. Collect it and send it to the dump.

Fix 
 any oil leaks to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil.

Oil 
 leaks to the ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil 
 and ground water and eventually on the ecosystem."It takes only I 
 liter of Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to render 1,000,000 liters 
 of potable water useless for human consumption

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Mechanical Check

items:
Check all gasket 
 surfaces on the transformer and on-load tap changer for tightness,

Make sure that the 
 oil connection on the cover of the transformer are tightened,

Make sure that oil 
 drain devices on the transformer tank are tightened,

Check of the 
 insulating oil level in the conservator for transformer oil.

Inspect the oil 
 level in the oil level gauge.

Check the oil 
 temperature on the oil level gauge. 
 The oil level in the conservator must be 
 in accordance with the rated hight depending on working temperature.

Check the breather 
 of the conservator for transformer oil.

Through by clean 
 all porcelain surfaces on all bushings.

Check for correct 
 oil level in all transformer bushings.

Check the fan 
 control.

Set the selectro 
 switch - in the cabinet for fan control - to position manual operation. this 
 way setting the fans to operations.

Check each individual fan, if its sense of rotation is correct, the air stream ought to 
 be directed aganist the radiators.

Read just the 
 contacts of the thermal image relay:
 Contact fan ON = + 60ºC
 Contact fan Off = + 50 ºC

Check the colour of the drying agent in the 
 hreather (Silicagel) must be blue.
Check the oil level in the vessel for oil seal.

Readjust the contact of the thermameter for oil 
 temp & winding trmp indicators according the following actuating temp values:
 For oil temp contact warning = + 
 70ºC
 contact tripping = + 90ºC
 For winding temp contact warning = + 75ºC
 contact tripping = + 95ºC

Check buchholz relay for transformer, it must not 
 contain any air accumulation.

Function test of the warning-and tripping float 
 according to the service instruction for buchhloz-relay.

sections.text: Electrical Check

items:
Check the H.V & 
 L.V connection according to service instruction of the cable function box.

Check HV, LV 
 neutral connection, for correct phase connection & good contact.

Check HV & LV 
 earthing insulator.

Check HV & LV 
 lighting arrestor.

Check the 
 connecting cables coming from the earthing insulator for good contact.

Check short 
 circuit connections of bushing and the earthing connection for good contact.

Check the earthing 
 connection between tank and cover, conservator and cover, terminal box, on 
 load tap changer and tank.

Check the on load 
 tap changer and set it to operation manual for each step.

Check the motor 
 drive and set it to operation.

Check the oil 
 level in the conservator..

Take an 
 oil sample from the transform through the oil drain respectively.

Check the 
 breakdoun voltage (must be at least 45kv).

Check the 
 oil in the on - load tap changer same as the oil of transformer.

Place transformer 
 back into normal operating condition.
